Bristol, UK SETsquared Business Acceleration Centre has partnered with High Tech Bristol and Bath, Engine Shed, and the University of the West of England (UWE, Bristol) to deliver the IoT Boost programme in Bristol & Bath starting from March 2017.
We were selected by UK Digital Catapult as one of six IoT Boost delivery partners in the UK.

If you are working on Internet of Things (IoT) enabled products, services and applications, you may be eligible to apply to the programme and secure a year long membership with the award winning SETsquared incubator, to help commercialise your technology and scale the business.
Bristol & Bath IoT community is invited to join a dedicated IoT Boost workshop, which will take place on 3 rd March 2017.
By mid-March 10 IoT businesses will be selected to join the programme and commence their membership with SETsquared.
Apply now to take advantage of this effective and proven incubation programme.

The programme has supported a diverse range of businesses, with many innovations addressing society’s greatest challenges including climate change, social inequality and online safety.
Enterprising Women is open to early-stage founders in the UK who identify as women or non-binary assigned female at birth with tech, tech-enabled or non-tech startups, business ideas or side hustles.
